references.title: DWDS: hoch
references.supports: The adjective hoch, attributive form hohe (usw.); DWDS has no entry for Hohen-Cremmen

notes.rationale: Fontane's fictional estate in Effi Briest, built like the Brandenburg names Hohen Neuendorf and Hohennauen from the inflected adjective hohen and a place name. No dictionary splits it. Hohen shows hoch's declension stem hoh with the attributive ending -en (ADR 0050), the hyphen is filler, and Cremmen is a PROPN Lemma of its own, as the novel spells it, not a spelling Variant of the town Kremmen (the user, 2026-10-25, #1241). Round 5's real-text draw 74; restored as a tuning record after the ruling, outside that frozen batch.
